description: This source file defines the Edit feature for articles in a web application, including command handling, validation, and database operations to update articles and their associated tags.

classes.name: Edit
classes.description: Encapsulates the logic for editing articles, including command validation and handling the update process.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Handles the update command, modifies the article, manages tags, and saves changes to the database.

methods.name: GetArticleTagsToCreate
methods.description: Determines which tags need to be added to the article based on the updated tag list.

methods.name: GetArticleTagsToDelete
methods.description: Determines which existing tags should be removed from the article.
